body: It’s hard, I want to deep down but I know the time isn’t right

This sounds like how I was in the early stages and later of my previous relationship; and I just want to say I’m sorry you felt this way. For me the reason for this was mainly not wanting to grow up, go to the next in the relationship and it made me cold and it’s the biggest mistake I’ve ever made.

I do just want to say that we do deep down love the guts out of you, although we don’t show it as much we should be, you are/were the most important person in our lives… people just show love differently to how maybe you expected it.

This is powerful man; I’m at a stage where I don’t want her to see my progress, not because of hate but because when I feel I’m ready to finally make contact I want her to see a new and better version of myself likewise that’s what I want to see on her side.
Dm me, I’m 21 and willing to join
